about: West Hants is a rural municipality in central Nova Scotia, inland from the Minas Basin and Avon River country toward Windsor, Falmouth, and Brooklyn. Villages, farms, and forest settlement share the landscape rather than forming a single city; neighbouring towns are counted separately. About 19,000 people live in West Hants.
seoSummary: Central Nova Scotia rural municipality of villages and farms toward Windsor and the Avon River—not a city.
